attchmntText: Rajnandini Metal Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rajnandini Metals Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Net sales for the quarter were 811 lakhs, with a loss before tax of 34 lakhs. For the half year, net sales stood at 6,006 lakhs, resulting in a profit before tax of 13 lakhs. The statutory auditor issued a qualified opinion due to tax demands. GST authorities raised a demand of 290.70 crores for ineligible input tax credit. Income Tax authorities raised a demand of 10.68 crores. The company has appealed both demands and has not provided for these liabilities in the financial statements. The Board Meeting started at 3:30 PM and concluded at 4:15 PM.

attchmntText: Rajnandini Metal Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation regarding withdrawal/recall of Resignation of Mr. Ashok Kalra, Managing Director of Rajnandini Metal Limited'.
voiceSummary: Rajnandini Metal Limited intimates that Mr. Ashok Kalra has withdrawn his resignation dated September 29, 2026, from the office of Managing Director. Mr. Kalra agreed to continue discharging all duties and responsibilities attached to the role. The company confirms there is no cessation of his directorship. A copy of the email from Mr. Kalra dated November 13, 2026, regarding the withdrawal is enclosed. Mr. Kalra undertakes to ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, and SEBI Listing Regulations. He also commits to completing formalities with the Registrar of Companies, including withdrawing Form DIR-11. The company has been authorized to intimate stock exchanges and regulatory authorities about the continuation of Mr. Kalra as Managing Director.
